description: Critical Android system core packages that MUST NEVER be removed or disabled. Touching these packages risks a bootloop, hard brick, or loss of core functionality including telephony, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, settings, package management, security keystore, biometrics, lockscreen, media/storage access, or Google Play Services boot dependencies.

rules.name: Android Framework
rules.description: Core Android framework package required by essentially every system operation and app.

rules.name: Android System UI
rules.description: Renders the status bar, navigation bar, notification shade, quick settings, and system dialogs. Removal causes loss of all UI shell and can cause bootloop.

rules.name: System Server
rules.description: Hosts core system services (activity manager, window manager, package manager, power manager, input, display, audio). The device cannot boot or function without it.

rules.name: Activity Manager Service
rules.description: Manages application lifecycle, activities, and process management. Required for all apps to run.

rules.name: Input Service
rules.description: Dispatches touch, keyboard, pointer, and gesture input events. Required for all user input.

rules.name: Display Service
rules.description: Manages display configuration, brightness, and screen state. Required for screen output.

rules.name: Power Manager Service
rules.description: Manages device sleep/wake, power states, and battery optimization. Required for power management.

rules.name: Audio Service
rules.description: Handles system audio routing, volume, and sound policy. Required for sound output.

rules.name: Package Manager Service
rules.description: System package manager used to install, query, update, and remove applications. Required to manage packages.

rules.name: AppOps Service
rules.description: Tracks per-app operation usage (camera, microphone, location, permissions). Required for permission enforcement.

rules.name: Backup Service
rules.description: System backup and restore service used for data migration and factory reset restore.

rules.name: Account Manager Service
rules.description: Manages system accounts and account sync. Required for account functionality.

rules.name: Location Service
rules.description: Fused location provider combining GPS, Wi-Fi, and cell signals. Required for location services.

rules.name: Wi-Fi Service
rules.description: Manages Wi-Fi connectivity, scanning, and association. Required for wireless networking.

rules.name: Wi-Fi Service HAL
rules.description: Wi-Fi HAL/service glue required for Wi-Fi firmware, scanning, and connectivity.

rules.name: Bluetooth
rules.description: Bluetooth stack and service required for Bluetooth devices and features.

rules.name: Bluetooth Server
rules.description: Bluetooth system service. Required for Bluetooth operation.

rules.name: NFC
rules.description: Near Field Communication service required for NFC tags and contactless payment.

rules.name: NFC Server
rules.description: NFC system service required for NFC operation.

rules.name: Telephony Provider
rules.description: Provides telephony data (SIM, SMS, call state) to the system. Required for mobile network and emergency calls.

rules.name: Telecom Service
rules.description: Manages calls (incoming, outgoing, emergency) and the in-call screen. Required for the dialer and telephony.

rules.name: Phone Telephony
rules.description: Legacy telephony phone app used by the framework for call handling and emergency services.

rules.name: Cell Broadcast Receiver
rules.description: Receives emergency alerts (AMBER, severe weather, presidential alerts). Required for emergency alert delivery.

rules.name: Telephony Radio Service
rules.description: RIL and telephony radio backend. Required for cellular network connectivity.

rules.name: Settings
rules.description: The system Settings app used to configure the device, manage apps, accounts, network, and security.

rules.name: Settings Provider
rules.description: Stores system, secure, and global settings. Required by the Settings app and many system services.

rules.name: Contacts Provider
rules.description: Central contacts storage used by dialer, contacts, and messaging apps.

rules.name: Package Installer
rules.description: Handles app installation, updates, permissions, and uninstallation. Required to manage packages.

rules.name: Documents UI
rules.description: Storage Access Framework UI used to pick files and folders. Required by file managers and apps accessing storage.

rules.name: Media Provider
rules.description: Indexes and provides access to media files (photos, video, audio). Required by gallery and media apps.

rules.name: External Storage
rules.description: Mounts and manages external/USB storage. Required for SD card and USB OTG access.

rules.name: KeyChain
rules.description: Provides apps access to system credentials and private keys stored in the keystore. Required for VPN, Wi-Fi enterprise, and secure apps.

rules.name: Biometrics
rules.description: System biometric framework. Required for fingerprint/face unlock and biometric-backed keystore access.

rules.name: Lock Settings
rules.description: Manages screen lock (PIN/pattern/password) and credential storage. Required to unlock and secure the device.

rules.name: Fingerprint Service
rules.description: Fingerprint hardware abstraction and enrollment service. Required for fingerprint unlock.

rules.name: Keyguard Lockscreen
rules.description: The secure lockscreen that protects the device when locked.

rules.name: System UI Navigation
rules.description: Navigation bar component of System UI. Removing can break on-screen navigation.

rules.name: Default Launcher
rules.description: Default home launcher. Required unless a third-party launcher is installed and set as default.

rules.name: Google Services Framework
rules.description: Core Google services framework required by Play Services and many Google apps; needed for boot stability on GMS devices.

rules.name: Google Play Services
rules.description: Google Play Services provides APIs and background services required by the OS and Google apps; removing can prevent boot or break core functions.

rules.name: Google Play Services Auth
rules.description: Google account authentication used by Play Services and system account sync.

rules.name: Google Play Services Account
rules.description: Google account management service required for GMS boot and sync.

rules.name: Google Extended Services
rules.description: Google extended services framework required for GMS functionality on many devices.

rules.name: Network Stack
rules.description: Core Android network stack implementation. Required for all IP connectivity.

rules.name: IPsec
rules.description: IPsec stack required for VPN and secure network tunnels.

rules.name: VPN Services
rules.description: VPN service required for virtual private network connectivity.

rules.name: IP Multimedia Subsystem
rules.description: IMS service for VoLTE/ViLTE/RCS over IP. Required for carrier voice and video services.

rules.name: RCS Service
rules.description: RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging service required by carriers.

rules.name: Carrier Config
rules.description: Carrier-specific configuration profiles required for correct mobile network operation.

rules.name: SIM Toolkit
rules.description: SIM Application Toolkit required by carriers for SIM-based services.

rules.name: In-Call UI
rules.description: In-call screen UI. Required for active call handling.

rules.name: SMS/Messaging
rules.description: System SMS/MMS app required for carrier messaging.

rules.name: SMS Push
rules.description: SMS push service required for carrier SMS delivery.

rules.name: Emergency Services
rules.description: Emergency services dialing and routing. Required for emergency call access.

rules.name: Shared Storage Backup
rules.description: Shared storage backup and restore service required for data migration.

rules.name: One Time Initializer
rules.description: OTA setup and one-time initialization service required for system setup.

rules.name: Partner Customization
rules.description: Partner/customization service required for OEM-carrier device configuration.

rules.name: Android Shell
rules.description: ADB shell itself. Required for ADB access to the device.

rules.name: Android System WebView
rules.description: System WebView used by apps to render web content. Required for many system and third-party apps.

rules.name: Play Licensing
rules.description: Google Play licensing service required by Play Store and paid apps.

rules.name: Input Devices
rules.description: Input device service required for keyboard, mouse, and gamepad input.
